message:
This PR implements comprehensive support for Across Lite v2 text format, extending the existing v1 text format support to include the new v2 features: REBUS sections for rebus entries and MARK sections for cell markup.

## Key Features Added

### v2 REBUS Section Support
- Parse and write rebus entries in the format `SYMBOL:cell1,cell2,cell3`
- Full integration with existing binary rebus extensions (`GRBS`, `RTBL`, `RUSR`)
- Support for multiple rebus symbols per puzzle

### v2 MARK Section Support  
- Parse and write cell markup in the format `TYPE:cell1,cell2,cell3`
- Supported markup types: `circle`, `incorrect`, `revealed`, `previously-incorrect`
- Maps directly to existing `GridMarkup` enum values (Circled=0x80, etc.)

### Enhanced Rebus Class
Added new helper methods to make puzzle construction easier:
- `add_rebus_entry(solution, cells)` - Add new rebus entries with automatic ID assignment
- `remove_rebus_entry(rebus_id)` - Remove existing rebus entries
- `clear_all_rebus()` - Clear all rebus data

### Bidirectional Format Conversion
- Complete `.puz` ↔ `.txt` v2 format conversion with full fidelity
- Round-trip conversion preserves all rebus and markup data
- Version-aware processing (auto-detects v1 vs v2 format headers)
- Backwards compatibility maintained with existing v1 files

## Example Usage

```python
import puz

# Read v2 text format with rebus and markup
puzzle = puz.read_text('puzzle_v2.txt')

# Convert existing .puz file to v2 text format
puzzle = puz.read('puzzle.puz')
v2_text = puz.to_text_format(puzzle, 'v2')

# Manual puzzle creation with rebus entries
puzzle = puz.Puzzle()
puzzle.width, puzzle.height = 5, 5
puzzle.solution = "HELLO.....WORLD....."
puzzle.fill = "-----..........-----"

# Add rebus entries easily
rebus = puzzle.rebus()
rebus.add_rebus_entry('HEART', [0, 24])  # First and last cells
rebus.add_rebus_entry('STAR', [12])      # Middle cell
rebus.save()

# Convert to v2 text format
v2_text = puz.to_text_format(puzzle, 'v2')
```

## Testing
- Added 5 comprehensive test functions covering all v2 functionality
- Full round-trip testing for both v1 and v2 formats
- Created test files demonstrating rebus entries and multiple markup types
- All existing tests continue to pass

The implementation facilitates seamless conversions between binary `.puz` and text `.txt` formats as requested, including advanced features like rebus entries and cell markup. Manual puzzle construction is now significantly easier with the enhanced helper methods.

Fixes #48.
